name: Nemuribuka Maruri
source:
"......More, I want to get along. With you, I want to talk more and more."

Likes: Anime, manga, B movie (splatter film, etc.)

[url=/c113574]Kyouhei[/url]'s classmate, a gloomy girl, and a second-year student who doesn't belong to any club.

A timid and introverted girl with negative thoughts and poor communication skills. Unable to fit in with her classmates, she is always alone in the class, reading books or pretending to sleep to get by.

She speaks in low and quiet voice, befitting her personalities, and has a hard time looking the other person in the eyes during a conversation. However, once she gets along with someone, she sometimes become a braggart.

She likes anime, manga, B movie, etc., and has vast knowledge of the occult. She is also familiar with the island belief in the octopus god.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/samenana/character/maruri.html]Official website[/url]]
